note: Both sets cover essentially the same nine facts with the same quotes and the same duplication of the 1x4 cedar T&G siding/cladding item. Set A is slightly more faithful: it keeps the 'steel' condition on the 1/8" cable railing and records the 2x4 dimension as part of the handrail attribute, whereas Set B drops the condition and reduces the handrail claim to a bare material. Neither set captures the powder-coated finish on the steel flatbar railing posts or the PV solar array shown on both elevations.
remarks: Both sets quote 'RAILING POSTS STEEL FLATBAR', which is stitched together from separate labels ('POWDERCOATED STEEL FLATBAR' and 'RAILING POSTS' / 'RAILING POST TYP.'); the powder-coated finish is lost in both. The 1x4 cedar T&G item appears twice in each set (once as siding, once as cladding) — the page labels it both ways in different elevations, so it is one fact under two names. Both sets also omit the PV SOLAR ARRAY callouts and the note that solar thermal tube array spacing may be larger with valves/piping not shown.
